data.one_liner: Draw text or patterns along a given Flutter path using Canvas extensions.
data.what_it_does: Provides canvas extensions to render text or custom drawing patterns along any custom path. It handles non-continuous paths and calculates spacing between pattern elements automatically.
use_when: You need to render text along a custom curved or straight path
You need to repeat a pattern or custom shape along a path
avoid_when: You need standard UI layout widgets without dealing directly with the canvas
strengths: Supports drawing both text and repeating patterns along paths
weaknesses: Text is clipped if it is larger than the given path
Limited documentation beyond basic canvas extension examples
